purpose: Qualify a stronger released native RoboCasa baseline before Astra interventions. This 21-episode screen is not a 2500-episode leaderboard reproduction.

criteria.success: Native environment info.success, not visual judgement
criteria.initially_successful_resets: Excluded with error, never count as policy success
criteria.truncated_worker: Report incomplete separately; never silently count as success or drop
criteria.first5_selection: First five by released episode index, not selected by outcome
criteria.policy_rng: One native persistent server RNG stream, initialized at 7. Subset scheduling differs from original 8-server full benchmark, so exact trajectory reproduction is not asserted.
criteria.comparison: Previous pi05 task/seed cases require matching simulator state and model hashes before calling them paired. Native execution prefixes differ (Xiaomi16, pi05 5).
criteria.coverage: CloseFridge atomic seen; PackIdenticalLunches composite seen; ArrangeBreadBasket composite unseen; LoadPreparedFood Human300 seen but not in target50.
criteria.physical_rollout: One policy execution after explicit env.reset, until success, environment termination, or full task horizon. Constructor setup resets and action chunks are separately counted.
criteria.video: Three original cameras, stride2,10fps to match native20Hz physical time.
